facades.name: entrance front on the IJsbaanpad (w04-8)
facades.note: TMX7316010203-002125_pano_0000_000162 (2021). Five glazed modules between round concrete columns (columns 0.34 m, wider than the ribbon gap: five openings), a blank brick module at the west end; above them the concrete lintel with one long slot per module (six).
